questions.exp: 'Britain and the British Seas' Mackinder ki pustak hai, Dudley Stamp ki nahi. Sahi: La Géographie Humaine – Jean Brunhes; Geography: A Modern Synthesis – Peter Haggett; The Spirit and Purpose of Geography – S.W. Wooldridge.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'आचरणपरक भूगोल' से सम्बन्धित नहीं है?
questions.exp: Yi-Fu Tuan manavtavaadi bhugol se jude hain, aacharanparak (vyavaharvaadi) se nahi. Book: 1960 ke dashak me matratmak kranti ke virodh me aacharanparak kranti aayi; prarambhik vikas me White, William Kirk, Hagerstrand, Gilbert White, Wolpert, David Huff, Brookfield, Downs, Burton, Kates aadi ka yogdan. Kirk aur Gould ne vyavaharvaadi bhugol ko samast bhugol ki shakha maana; Gilbert White ne baadh ki pratikriya me manviya aacharan par shodh kiya; Pred ne 1967 me vyavaharvaadi dhanche ka prayog prastut kiya.

questions.q: प्रत्यक्षवाद की मुख्य अवधारणा है:
questions.exp: Pratyakshvaad ek darshanik vichar hai jise anubhavvaad ke naam se bhi jaana jata hai; ye gyan ko tathyon aur unke beech sambandh tak seemit rakhta hai. Pratyakshvaadi maante hain ki vigyan sirf anubhavik prashnon se juda hai; naitik aadarsh jaise – pratha, parampara, aadarsh, vishwas – ko pramanit nahi kiya ja sakta. Isliye isme dono tatva (anubhavvaad aur niyam-siddhant nirmaan) samahit.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (मानचित्रण विधि): 1. समान रेखा 2. वर्णमात्री 3. रंगत रेखी (कोरोक्रोमैटिक) 4. वर्ण प्रतीकी (कोरोस्कीमैटिक)
सूची-II (मानचित्र): A. खनिजों का वितरण B. तापमान का वितरण C. भूमि उपयोग D. जनसंख्या का घनत्व
questions.exp: Samman rekha – taapmaan ka vitaran; varnmatri (choropleth) – jansankhya ka ghanatva; rangat rekhi (chorochromatic) – bhoomi upyog; varn prateeki (choroschematic) – khanijon ka vitaran.

questions.q: मिश्रित पिरामिड है:
questions.exp: Mishrit pyramid ek-vimiya aarekh hai. Saamanyatah saadharan aankdon ko dikhane ke liye saral dand banaye jaate hain; jab ek hi kul (bade) aankde ke kai ghatak hon to ek hi dand ke kai bhaag karke dikhaya jaata hai – ise mishrit dand aarekh kehte hain; kyunki isme ek hi aayam (lambai) ka prayog hota hai, ye ek-vimiya hai.

questions.q:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए एवं नीचे दिए कूट से सही उत्तर चुनिए:
1. वारेनियस ने अपनी पुस्तक 'ज्योग्राफी यूनिवर्सिली' में उद्देश्यवादी विचारों को अपेक्षित किया।
2. रेटजेल ने 'राज्य की जैविक' अवधारणा को प्रतिपादित किया।
3. अल-मसूदी ने वाष्पीकरण एवं संघनन की प्रक्रियाओं का वर्णन किया।
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (a) – kathan 1 aur 2 sahi. Al-Masudi ek niyativaadi chintak the jinhone bataya ki pashu aur paudhe apne paryavaran ke anusar anukoolit hote hain; apne samay ke prasiddh jalvayu vaigyanik the aur mansoon ka achha vivran diya, lekin vashpikaran aur sanghan par koi mahatvapurn vichar nahi diya – isliye kathan 3 galat.

questions.q: प्रकीर्ण बस्तियाँ मिलती हैं:
questions.exp: Australia, New Zealand aur America me prakeern bastiyon wale krishi grih hain; yahan prakeern bastiyan basne ka kaaran krishi yogya bhoomi ki prachurta aur bade khetfal tatha yantriya suvidha ka hona; yahan pratyek kisan ke paas kai sau acre bhoomi ke farm hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ग्रामीण अधिवासों का कार्य है?
questions.exp: Gramin adhivason me prathamik kriyaein hoti hain jinke antargat dharatal se kachche padarth nikalne ya utkhanan ke kaarya – khadya sangrah, aakhet, matsyan, pashucharan, lakdi katna, krishi aur khanan – aate hain. Isliye saare vikalp.

questions.q: जलोढ़ मैदानों में निम्नलिखित में से अधिवासों का कौन सा प्रतिरूप नहीं मिलता?
questions.exp: Book ke anusaar aayatakar prtiroop ke gaon mukhyatah marusthaliya kshetron me milte hain, jahan dhool bhari aandhiyan chalti hain athwa maidani bhaagon me jahan daaku ya luteron ke aakraman ka bhay hota hai; jheel/talaab ke nikat chaukor gaon jinhe parkota ghere rehta hai. Vishwa ki lagbhag 60% jansankhya gramin adhivason me rehti hai aur adhikansh log aayatakar prtiroop ke adhivason me (book).

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (नगर): 1. नई दिल्ली 2. रोम 3. दुर्गापुर 4. मसूरी
सूची-II (कार्य का प्रकार): A. औद्योगिक शहर B. स्वास्थ्य शहर (रिसॉर्ट शहर) C. सांस्कृतिक D. प्रशासनिक
questions.exp: Nai Delhi – prashasanik; Rome – sanskritik; Durgapur – audyogik; Mussoorie – swasthya (resort) shahar.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सुमेलित नहीं है?
questions.exp: Megalopolis shabd Mark Jefferson ka nahi, Jean Gottmann ka hai. Book: American samajshastri Lewis Mumford ne nagaron ke kaaryon aur aitihasik tathyon ke sookshm adhyayan ke baad vikas ki 6 avasthayein batayi – Eopolis, Polis, Metropolis, Megalopolis, Tyrannopolis, Nekropolis. Sannagar (conurbation) – Patrick Geddes; koti-aakar niyam – G.K. Zipf.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित विद्युत चुम्बकीय तरंगों में किसका तरंगदैर्घ्य सर्वाधिक लम्बी है?
questions.exp: Radio tarangon ka tarangdairghya > 100 cm hota hai; vidyut-chumbakiya spectrum me sabse lambi tarangein yahi hain; radio prasaran, vanijyik prasaran aur jalvayu sambandhi soochnaon me upyogi.

questions.q: कोटि-आकार नियम के अनुसार, यदि पाँचवीं कोटि के शहर की जनसंख्या 1500000 हो, तो सबसे बड़े शहर की जनसंख्या क्या होगी?
questions.exp: Koti-aakar niyam: n-ve koti ke shahar ki jansankhya = sabse bade shahar ki jansankhya / n. Isliye sabse bada shahar = 15,00,000 × 5 = 75,00,000. Ye ek saiddhantik model hai jo pradesh me nagariya bastiyon ke unke aakar ke anusar vitaran ke prtiroop ko batata hai; G.K. Zipf ne 1949 me koti-aakar niyam ki vistrit vyakhya ki.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से जनसांख्यिकीय संक्रमण की कौन सी अवस्था अल्पविकास की अवस्था को दर्शाती है?
questions.exp: Ucch sthir avastha alpvikas dikhati hai. Jansankhyiki sankraman siddhant Thompson aur Notestein ne diya; ye vikasit deshon (Europe, America, Australia) ke janam dar, mrityu dar, prakritik vriddhi dar ki pravritti par aadharit hai. Iske anusaar jansankhya visphot ka purvaanuman lagaya ja sakta hai; jansankhyiki ucch sthir avastha alpvikas darshati hai. (Srot: Jansankhya Bhugol, Chandna – book).

questions.q:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सुमेलित युग्म सही है?
(1) गुरुत्व मॉडल - जे.क्यू.स्टेवार्ट
(2) न्यूनतम प्रयास सिद्धांत - जी.के. जिफ
(3) अंतरालवर्ती अवसर मॉडल - एस.ए. स्टोफर
questions.exp: Teeno sahi sumelit: gurutva model – J.Q. Stewart; nyuntam prayas siddhant – G.K. Zipf; antaralvarti avsar model – S.A. Stouffer.

questions.q: जनसंख्या की उम्र बढ़ना परिणाम है:
questions.exp: Janankiki sankraman ke siddhant ki teesri avastha me janam aur mrityu dono daron me prashansaniya kami hoti hai – janam dar 20 se 30 prati hazaar aur mrityu dar 10 se 15 prati hazaar tak. Ye avastha dheemi jansankhya vriddhi ki parichayak hai; Bharat sahit Poorvi Europe aur Madhya Asia ke deshon me dekhne ko milti hai. Ghatti janam aur mrityu dar dono se jansankhya ki umra badhti hai.

questions.q: दूर-संवेदन के बारे में निम्न में से क्या सत्य नहीं है?
o: भूस्थिर उपग्रह लगभग 36000 कि.मी. की ऊँचाई पर पृथ्वी के चारों ओर चक्कर लगाते हैं।
सूर्य-सिंक्रोनस उपग्रह का पथ उत्तर-दक्षिण है।
X - किरणें प्रमुखतया दूर-संवेदन में प्रयुक्त होती हैं।
इसरो ने सर्वप्रथम रूस से 'आर्यभट्ट' का अंतरिक्ष में शुभारंभ किया।
questions.exp: X-kiranein door-samvedan me pramukhta se prayog nahi hoti – vayumandal me poorntah avshoshit ho jaati hain, isliye door-samvedan me inka koi upyog nahi. Bhoosthir upgrah ~36,000 km oonchai par prithvi ka chakkar lagate hain; surya-synchronous upgrah ka path uttar-dakshin; Aryabhatt ISRO ne Rus se antariksh me bheja.

questions.q: कृषि का वह प्रकार जिसे बड़े आकार वाले खेतों में यांत्रिक विधियों से किया जाता है, कहलाती है:
questions.exp: Kaafi bade aakar ke kheton me yantrik vidhiyon se ki jaane wali kheti vistrit krishi kehlati hai. Isme shramikon ka upyog kam aur machinon ka adhik; machinon ka prati hectare utpadan kam hota hai lekin prati shramik utpadan aur kul utpadan adhik hota hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से फसलों के किस समूह को उन क्षेत्रों में उगाया जा सकता है, जहाँ तापमान 20° - 27° से. एवं वार्षिक वर्षा 150 सेमी. से अधिक हो?
questions.exp: Rubber, chawal aur jute ushna katibandhiya faslein hain. Chawal ke liye 24°–27°C taapmaan aur 125–200 cm varshik varsha, niyamit varsha; dhaan ke kheton me paani bhara rehna chahiye; mitti upjaau aur jaliya, sasta shram; mansoon pradesh ki jalvayu chawal ke liye vishesh roop se upyukt.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में कौन सा स्थानान्तरित कृषि का एक प्रकार नहीं है?
questions.exp: Fazenda (Brazil me kahwa/coffee ke bagaan) sthanantarit krishi nahi hai. Sthanantarit krishi me pehle vanon ko jalakar bhoomi ko saaf kiya jaata hai, 2–3 saal fasal, phir urvarata ghatne par naya sthan; ise 'kaatna aur jalana' (slash and burn) ya 'brush fallow' bhi kehte hain. Naam: Ray – Vietnam, Laos; Tavi – Malagasy; Masole – Madhya Africa; Logan – Paschimi Africa; Milpa – Madhya America; Chena – Sri Lanka; Tamrai – Thailand.

questions.q:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं।
अभिकथन (A): संरक्षण का अर्थ प्राकृतिक संसाधनों की सुरक्षा एवं अनुपयोग है।
कारण (R): संरक्षण, संसाधनों की मनुष्य के लिए सर्वाधिक सम्भव लम्बी समय अवधि के लिए निरन्तर आपूर्ति को सुनिश्चित करता है।
o: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है
(A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (b) – (A) galat, (R) sahi. Sansadhan sanrakshan ka arth 'anupyog' nahi balki tarksangat upyog hai: kisi kaal me praakritik sansadhan aadhar tatha jansankhya aur uske jeevan star ke beech santulit samanvay aur anukoolan. Isme na sirf tatkaleen samajik, aarthik tatha rajneetik kalyan ke kaaryon me uttarottar pragati, balki sansadhanon ka samyak upyog sarvashreshth bhavishya ki drishti se karna aur ve kam se kam durupyog-apshishtikaran tatha anaichhik shoshan se bachein – ye shamil hai.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (लेखक): 1. वेबर 2. स्मिथ 3. होटलिंग 4. हूवर
सूची-II (सिद्धांत): A. न्यूनतम उत्पादन लागत B. अधिकतम लाभ C. न्यूनतम परिवहन लागत D. बाजार प्रतिस्पर्धा
questions.exp: Weber – nyuntam parivahan laagat; Smith – adhiktam laabh; Hotelling – bazaar pratispardha; Hoover – nyuntam utpadan laagat.

questions.q: अग्रणी पेट्रोलियम उत्पादक देशों का सही अवरोही क्रम है:
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (c): USA, Saudi Arab, Rus, Iran. Petroleum ki utpatti samudri jeevon aur vanaspatiyon ke 10–20 crore varsh pehle ke avsadon me dabne se hui; ye avsadi chattanon ki gumbadakar sanrachna me paya jaata hai. Vartaman me pramukh petroleum utpadak USA, Saudi Arab, Rus, Iran.

questions.q: विश्व में अग्रणी चाँदी उत्पादक देश है:
questions.exp: Vishwa me agrani chaandi utpadak Mexico hai – Chihuahua aur Hidalgo (Pachuca) ki khanein. Chaandi aamtaur par seesa, jasta aur taambe ke saath mili paayi jaati hai; iske baad Peru, China, Poland bhi chaandi ke pramukh utpadak.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित परिवहन के प्रकारों में से किसकी टर्मिनल लागत न्यूनतम होती है?
questions.exp: Jal parivahan ki terminal laagat nyuntam hoti hai. Desh ka lagbhag 99% vyapar samudri marg se hota hai; vikasshil deshon me Bharat ke paas vyaparik jahazon ka sabse bada bedha hai; vyaparik jahazrani me Bharat vishwa me 17ve sthaan par (book). Parivahan ke prakaron me jal parivahan ki terminal laagat anya ki tulna me kam.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से ओपेक सदस्यों का कौन सा समूह सही है?
questions.exp: UAE, Algeria, Libya, Iraq OPEC sadasya hain. OPEC 1960 me petroleum ke moolyon sambandhi neetiyon ko lagu karne ke liye petroleum utpadak deshon dwara banaya gaya; book ke samay 13 sadasya – Algeria, Ecuador, Gabon, Indonesia, Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Libya, Nigeria, Qatar, Saudi Arab, UAE, Venezuela; mukhyalay Vienna (Austria).

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसमें मैकिंडर ने हृदय-स्थल का सिद्धांत प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (b) – 'The Geographical Pivot of History'. Mackinder British bhugolvettaon me sabse vikhyat aur British bhugol sampradaay ke sansthapak; 1904 me Royal Geographical Society ke samaksh nibandh padha 'The Geographical Pivot of History', jisme bataya ki samudri shakti ka yug samapt ho chuka hai aur bhavishya me sthal shakti nirnayak hogi.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सामाजिक-कल्याण का सूचक नहीं माना जाता है?
questions.exp: Apraadh samajik kalyan ka soochak nahi maana jaata, balki samaj ke vinaash ka kaaran hai. Kisi desh ke vikas me mahila saksharta ka mahatvapurn yogdan; 2011 jangarna ke anusaar sampoorn saksharta 73.0% (purush 80.9%, mahila 64.6%) – mahila saksharta me kaafi sudhar.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी सर्वाधिक बोली जाने वाली भाषा है?
questions.exp: Duniya me sabse adhik boli jaane wali bhasha Mandarin hai. Book: UN ke anusaar vishwa me boli jaane wali bhashaon ki sankhya 6809; inme 90% bhashaon ko bolne waalon ki sankhya 1 lakh se kam; lagbhag 150–200 bhashaein aisi jinhe 10 lakh se adhik log bolte hain. Sabse adhik boli jaane wali: 1. Mandarin 2. Angrezi 3. Hindi 4. Spanish 5. Rusi.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में किसने प्रजातियों के वर्गीकरण में 'त्वचा के रंग' को एक मानक माना है?
questions.exp: Cuvier ne twacha ke rang ke aadhar par manav prajatiyon ko teen vargon me baanta: 1. Caucasoid – shwet prajati (Leucoderm); 2. Mongoloid – peeli prajati (Xanthoderm); 3. Negroid – kaali prajati (Melanoderm). Haddon aur Huxley ne baalon ke rang aur banawat ke aadhar par vargikaran kiya.

questions.q: "किसे मिलता है, क्या, कहाँ एवं कैसे" यह आधारभूत बिन्दु है:
questions.exp: 'Who gets what, where and how' kalyankari bhugol ka aadharbhoot bindu hai. Kalyankari bhugol ka vikas 1970 ke dashak me hua, jo samajik samasyaon ke samadhan se sambandhit hai; matratmak kranti aur aacharanparak kranti ki pratikriya me viksit. D.M. Smith ke anusaar ismein kaun, kya, kahan aur kaise prapt karta hai – ka adhyayan; vibhinn manviya kriyaon ki avasthiti ke sandarbh me aisi yojana jisse kam se kam moolya dekar adhik logon ko adhiktam laabh mile.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (जनजाति): 1. एस्किमो 2. लैप्स 3. मसाई 4. पिग्मी
सूची-II (क्षेत्र): A. कनाडा B. पूर्वी अफ्रीका C. स्कैण्डेनेविया D. कांगो बेसिन
questions.exp: Eskimo – Canada; Lapps – Scandinavia; Masai – Poorvi Africa; Pygmy – Congo basin.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी जनजाति पशुचारण से सम्बन्धित है?
questions.exp: Masai log pashupalan ke roop me poorvi Africa ke Kenya, uttari Tanzania tatha poorvi Uganda ke pathari pradeshon me rehte hain; inke niwas sthaan Victoria jheel se poorv me. Ye ooncha bhaag rift ghati se khandit; Masai logon ka pramukh dharmik neta 'Laibon'; inki sabse mahatvapurn sampatti pashu; ye paaltu pashuon ki hatya nahi karte, gaayon ka maans unke swatah marne par khaate hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक अपकिरण की सापेक्ष माप है?
questions.exp: Vicharan gunank (coefficient of variation) apkiran ki saapeksh maap hai. Maadhya vichalan, jise ausat vichalan bhi kehte hain, kisi shreni ke moolyon aur uske maadhya ya madhyika ke antar ke dhanatmak maanon ka samantar maadhya hota hai; saiddhantik roop se ye vichalan madhyika se lena achha hai kyunki iska kul yog nyuntam hota hai, par vyavhaar me samantar maadhya se liye jaate hain – isliye maadhya vichalan ke naam se prachalit.

questions.q: क्षेत्रीय विस्तार की दृष्टि से निम्नलिखित में से कौन सबसे छोटा है?
questions.exp: Kshetriy vistaar me sabse chhota 'sanskritik kshetra' (book ka vikalp d). Sanskritik visheshtaon ki samanta ke aadhar par vishwa ko sanskritik parimandalon me vargikrit kiya jaata hai; is sandarbh me Spencer aur Thomas, Russell aur Kniffen, Broek, D. Whittlesey ke prayas mahatvapurn. Sanskritik pradeshon ki teen padanukramik shreniyan: sanskritik mandal → sanskritik parimandal → sanskritik pradesh → sanskritik kshetra.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रजाति ने कांस्य संस्कृति का सूत्रपात किया एवं सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता को विकसित किया?
questions.exp: Kansya sanskriti ka sootrapaat aur Sindhu ghati sabhyata ko viksit karne ka shrey bhoomadhyasagariya prajati ko jaata hai, jo Caucasian ki sabse mahatvapurn prajati hai. Iski pramukh shaaririk visheshtayein: ausat kad, lamba chehra, patle honth, patli nukeeli seedhi naak, kaala ya bhoora baal, shareer par saadharan baal aur gehuan rang. Mediterranean me bhi teen upprajatiyan: vastavik bhoomadhyasagariya, Atlanto-Mediterranean aur Irani Afghani; naamkaran bhoomadhya sagar ke charon or vistrit hone ke kaaran.

questions.q: Polar fleeing force relates to which among the following?
questions.exp: Polar fleeing (dhruv palayan) bal prithvi ke ghoornan se sambandhit hai. Wegener ne pravah sambandhi bal ke antargat bataya ki Pangaea ka vibhajan hua to usme do disha me pravah hue – uttar ki or (bhoomadhya rekha ki or) aur paschim ki or. Bhoomadhya rekha ki or pravah gurutva bal aur plavanshilta ke bal (force of buoyancy) se; mahadweepon ka paschim disha me pravah surya aur chandrama ke jwariya bal se.

questions.q: Which one of the following types of climate is found along both east and west side of Rocky mountains in the United States of America?
questions.exp: Steppe jalvayu USA me Rocky parvat ke poorvi aur paschimi dono or paayi jaati hai. Steppe jalvayu madhya akshanshon me mahadweepon ke aantarik bhaagon me; Eurasia ke shitoshn ghaas pradesh ko steppe kehte hain – Hungary me Puszta, Manchuria ke maidan, uttari America me Canada aur USA ke vistrit shitoshn ghaas maidan ka sthaniya naam Prairie.

questions.q: Who among the following coined the term Cosmography and divided it into 'Uranography' and 'Geography'?
questions.exp: Alexander von Humboldt ne Cosmography (1845–1862, paanch khand) pratipadit karke use 'Uranography' aur 'Geography' me baanta. Humboldt ne 1789 se lekar mrityu tak anek lekh-pustakein prakashit ki; antim aur mahatvapurn granth 'Kosmos'. Pramukh rachnaein: Rhine landes basalt (1789), Geognosia (1793), naye mahadweep ke bhoomadhyrekhiya pradesh ki yatra (30 ankon me, 1815–1820), Madhya Asia (1829), Mexico aur Cuba ka pradeshik bhugol.

questions.q: Who among the following was first to formulate the method of crop combination?
questions.exp: J.C. Weaver ne sarvapratham fasal sanyojan vidhi taiyar ki. Weaver ne shasya sanyojan nirdhaaran me pashuon ko sthan nahi diya; krishi pradeshon me pashu aur faslon ka parasparik sambandh mahatvapurn. Weaver ke atirikt Doi (1959), Thomas, Scott, Johnson, Rafiullah (1956) aadi videshi vidwan aur Banerjee, N.P. Singh jaise Bharatiya vidwanon ne bhi shasya sanyojan vidhi ka adhyayan kiya.

questions.q: A graph showing the relationship between wet-bulb temperature and Relative Humidity for all months of a year for a place is called:
questions.exp: Ek graph jisme kisi sthan ke ek varsh ke sabhi maheenon ke aardra-bulb taapmaan aur saapeksh aardrata ka sambandh dikhaya jaata hai use climograph kehte hain. Ise Griffith Taylor ne banaya; is aarekh ko dekhkar kisi sthan ki jalvayu sambandhi saamanya dashaon ki jaankari mil jaati hai. Hythergraph me masik taapmaan aur varsha ke moolyon ko koti (ordinates) aur bhuj (abscissae) me ankit kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: How many states of India are situated along the coastline?
questions.exp: Bharat ke 9 rajya tat par hain – Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha aur Paschim Bangal. Bharat ka kul kshetrafal 32,87,263 km², vishwa ka ~2.4%; Bharat ki aakriti chaturbhujakar; uttar-dakshin vistaar 3214 km aur poorv-paschim 2933 km; dono ke beech antar 281 km; kshetrafal ki drishti se vishwa me saatvaan sthaan.

questions.q: Which of the following scholars are associated with the concept of geosyncline?
questions.exp: Bhoosanati ki sankalpana ke vikas ke kshetra me pratham prayas Hall aur Dana ne kiya, jabki bhoosanati sankalpana ko siddhant ka roop Kober ne diya. Bhoosanatiyan lambe, sankre aur uthle jaliya bhaag hoti hain jinme talchhati nikshep ke saath-saath tali me dhansaav hota rehta hai. Bhoosanati se sambandhit siddhant: parvat nirmaan – Kober; taapiya sankuchan – Jeffreys; mahadweepiya fislan – Daly; sanvahan tarang – Holmes; radioactivity – Joly.

questions.q: Saline soils are the result of:
o: Very high precipitation and high leaching of the soil
High rate of evaporation and very little leaching of the soil
High precipitation and very little leaching of the soil
questions.exp: Khaari mitti ucch dar ke vashpikaran aur mitti ke bahut kam nikshalan ka parinaam hai. Lavaniya mrida ko kshariya mrida, reh, usar, kallar mrida ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai. Is mrida me sodium, calcium aur potassium ki adhikta tatha nitrogen aur choone ki kami; isme nariyal aur taad ki achhi fasal; harit khaad aur gypsum se kshariyata kam ki ja sakti hai. Note: Bharat me kshariya mrida Gujarat, Punjab, Haryana, paschim Rajasthan aur Kerala ke tateey kshetron me.

questions.q: Which among the following is NOT a major centres of Brass ware in India?
questions.exp: Ranchi Bharat ke peetal bartanon ke pramukh kendron me shamil nahi. Moradabad, Madurai aur Cuttack shamil hain. Moradabad ko 'peetal nagri' ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai. Peetal bartan udyog Varanasi, Mirzapur, Moradabad aadi me; peetal ki moorti, ghungroo, ghanti aadi Madurai, Saharanpur me bhi bante hain; Ranchi 'peetal' udyog ka pramukh kendra nahi.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
questions.exp: Herbivore (trinbhakshi) prathamik upbhokta hai, dwitiyak nahi – isliye (d) galat. Sahi: swaposhi – utpadak; paraposhit – upbhokta; mritopjeevi – vighatak; mansahari – dwitiyak upbhokta. Poshan star: prathamik utpadak (paudhe) → prathamik upbhokta (shakahari) → dwitiyak upbhokta (mansahari) → tritiyak upbhokta (ucch mansahari, manushya).

questions.q: Which one of the following climatic regions lies between 25°-40° latitudes?
questions.exp: China tulya athwa aardra uposhna katibandhiya jalvayu pradesh ka vistaar 25°–40° akshanshon ke beech hai. Is jalvayu me greeshmakaal me ausat taapmaan 24°–26.6°C. Ye jalvayu bhoomadhya rekha ke dono or 30°–40° akshanshon ke beech mahadweepon ke poorvi bhaagon me; ye jalvayu bhootal ke lagbhag 1.7% bhaag par. Savanna tulya jalvayu bhoomadhya rekha ke dono or 5°–10° se praarambh hokar 15°–20° akshansh tak; savanna me ausat varshik varsha 100–150 cm.

questions.q: Kirkuk, one of the most important oil fields in the world is located in:
questions.exp: Kirkuk Iraq me hai. Petroleum tertiary yug ki jalaj avsadi shailon ki 'chattani tel' hai, jo hydrocarbon yaugikon ka mishran; isse petrol, diesel, ether, mom aadi praapt hote hain. Vishwa me sarvadhik tel vitaran ke kshetra: Iraq – Kirkuk, Mosul, Rumaila, Basra; Kuwait – Burgan, Rudhan; Saudi Arab – Abqaiq, Qatif, Ghawar, Dammam, Abu Saafa; Iran – Gach Saran, Marun, Aghajari, Lali; CIS – Baku, Grozny.

questions.q: Who among the following scholars put forth the 'Glacial Control Theory' of origin of coral reefs?
questions.exp: R.A. Daly ne 1915 me praval bhittiyon ki utpatti ki vyakhya hetu 'himani niyantran siddhant' diya. Daly ka vichar ki saagaron me praval bhittiyon ka nirmaan Pleistocene himkaal ke baad hi hua; inke anusaar praval bhittiyon ke vikas aur samudra jal ke taapmaan me ghanishth sambandh; isi aadhar par unhone praval bhittiyon aur atoll sambandhi vyakhya prastut ki. Praval bhitti sambandhi anya siddhant: sthir sthal siddhant (1880) – Murray; avtalan siddhant (1837) – Darwin.

questions.q: Which one of the following landforms is NOT among Karst topography features?
questions.exp: Seif-tibba pawan dwara ret ke nikshep se bani sthalakriti hai, karst nahi. Yuvala, andhi ghati aur dhansti nivesika karst apardanatmak sthalakritiyan hain. Pawan dwara nirmit sthalakritiyan – apardanatmak: apvahan basin, vatgart, inselberg, chhatrak shila (mushroom rock), bhoostambh (demoiselles), zeugen, yardang, dreikanter, jaalidar shila, playa, pul tatha khidki; nikshepatmak: baalukastup, barkhan, anudairdhya baalukastup, loess, seif aadi.

questions.q: Behaviourism came into existence as a reaction against:
questions.exp: Vyavaharvaad parimanatmakta (quantification) ke pratikriyaswaroop astitva me aaya. Vyavaharvaadi bhugol me manav vyavhar ko sabse adhik mahatvapurn maana gaya hai tatha tathyon ke bhaugolik vishleshan me manushya ke vyaktigat ya saamuhik aacharan ko praathamikta di gayi. Vyavaharvaadi chintan ke praarambhik vikas (1960 ke dashak) me William Kirk ka yogdan mahatvapurn; Sauer, J.K. Wright, G.F. White ne bhi manav vyavhar tatha bodh aur anubhuti ki bhoomika ke mahatva par aawaaz uthayi, par tatkaalin paristhitiyon me in vidwanon ke vichaar bhaugolik chintan ko nayi disha nahi de sake. 1960 ke dashak me vyavharparak bhugol me 'mastishk me bhugol' ya 'manasik maanchitra' ka adhyayan lokpriya hua; Downs, Downs evam Stea, Gould evam White ki rachnaon ka yogdan.

questions.q:
Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
(Mineral – Mining City) 1. Copper – Chitradurga 2. Iron ore – Ballari 3. Manganese – Bhilwara 4. Bauxite – Katni
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (c) – 1 aur 3 sumelit nahi. Book ka sahi sumelan: tamba – Malanjkhand, Taregaon; lauh ayask – Bellary; manganese – Keonjhar, Bonai; bauxite – Katni.

questions.q: Which among the following is NOT correctly matched? (Theory/Rule – Scholar)
questions.exp: Bahunaabhik siddhant B.J.L. Berry ka nahi, Harris aur Ullman (1945) ka hai. Sahi: koti-aakar niyam (1949) – G.K. Zipf; sankendriya valay siddhant (1925) – E.W. Burgess; kendra sthal siddhant (1933) – Walter Christaller.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT an example of sedimentary rock?
questions.exp: Slate avsadi chattan ka udaharan nahi (ye roopantarit chattan hai), jabki koyla, shale, potash avsadi chattan ke udaharan hain. 'Avsadi' chattan ka nirmaan avsadon ke samekan ke falswaroop hota hai. Yeh chattan bhoopristh ke sarvadhik kshetrafal par paayi jaati hai – yadyapi bhoopristh ka lagbhag 75% bhaag avsadi shailon se aavrit hai, tathapi crust ki banawat me iska yog keval 5% hai, jabki 95% bhaag aagneya tatha roopantarit chattanon dwara bana hai.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Mines) with List-II (Minerals):
A. Koraput B. Sundargarh C. Khetri D. Giridih
1. Iron ore 2. Coal 3. Bauxite 4. Copper
questions.exp: Koraput – bauxite; Sundargarh – lauh ayask; Khetri – tamba; Giridih – koyla.

questions.q: Where is the source of light kept in Gnomonic Polar Zenithal Projection?
o: In the centre of the Globe
One the periphery of the globe
questions.exp: Kendrak dhruviya khamadhya (gnomonic) prakshep me prakash ka srot globe ke kendra me rakha jaata hai. Vikasniya prishth ki sthiti ke aadhar par khamadhya prakshep teen prakaar ke: 1. bhoomadhyrekhiya khamadhya, 2. dhruviya khamadhya, 3. tiryak khamadhya prakshep.

questions.q:
Match List-I (River Valley Project) with List-II (River):
A. Rihand Project B. Nagarjun Sagar Project C. Pochampad Project D. Matatila Project
1. Godavari 2. Betwa 3. Rihand 4. Krishna
questions.exp: Rihand – Rihand; Nagarjuna Sagar – Krishna; Pochampad – Godavari; Matatila – Betwa.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT a glacial topography?
questions.exp: Yardang pawan dwara nirmit apardanatmak sthalakriti hai, jabki kettle, drumlin aur esker himani nirmit nikshepatmak sthalakritiyan hain. Himani nirmit sthalakritiyan – apardanatmak: U-aakar ki ghati, latakti ghati, cirque (corrie), tarn, horn aur girishring, arete (teekshna katak), nunatak, shring puchh (crag and tail), roches moutonnées, himsopan, fiord; nikshepjanit: himod (moraines), drumlin, esker, kame, kettle, hummock, outwash (himnad avkshep).

questions.q:
Assertion (A): There is neither net erosion nor net deposition in a graded river.
Reason (R): It denotes balance between available energy and work to be done.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Kramabaddh (graded) nadi dwara na to shuddh apardan hota hai aur na hi shuddh nikshepan, kyunki ye uplabdh urja aur kiye jaane wale kaarya ke beech santulan darshati hai.

questions.q: 'The Mobility Transition Theory' of migration was propounded by:
questions.exp: Pravas se sambandhit 'gatisheelta sankraman siddhant' Zelinsky dwara pratipadit kiya gaya. Pravasan niyamon ko banane wale pehle vidwan E.G. Ravenstein the. Pravasan kisi ek sthan, kshetra, desh ya mahadweep se manushyon ke doosre sthan me jaakar basne ki prakriya hai. Pravas se sambandhit kuch mahatvapurn siddhant: nyuntam prayas – G.K. Zipf; gurutva model – W.J. Reilly; spardhatmak sthanantaran model – Stouffer; sthanantaran siddhant – E.S. Lee.

questions.q: In India, the share of female migration as compared to male migration is higher in which of the following migration stream?
questions.exp: Bharat me purush pravas ki apeksha mahila pravas gaon se gaon ki or adhik hai. Ye pravas mukhya roop se krishi pradhan arthvyavastha wale deshon me hota hai; is pravas ka ek kaaran mahilaon ka vivah ke baad sthanantaran. Saamanyatah pravasan ke chaar pravah: gramin se gramin, gramin se nagariya, nagariya se gramin, nagariya se nagariya.

questions.q: Gaza strip is located between which of the following two countries?
questions.exp: Gaza patti Israel aur Misra ke beech sthit hai. Sinai prayadweep Misra ka ek trikonakaar prayadweep hai jo uttar me bhoomadhya sagar aur dakshin-paschim me Lal sagar ki Swez khaadi tatha dakshin-poorv me Lal sagar ki Aqaba khaadi ke beech; Sinai aur Misra ki mukhyabhoomi Swez nahar dwara alag; Sinai prayadweep ke sudur uttari-poorvi bhaag ko Gaza patti kaha jaata hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched? (Author – Book)
questions.exp: Al-Masudi ki pustak 'Routes and Realms' nahi – book ke anusaar Al-Masudi ki pustak 'Sone ki charagahein evam jawaharaton ki khaanein' (Meadows of Gold) hai aur 'A Book of Routes and Realms' Ibn Haukal ki. Sahi: Al-Balkhi – Kitab-ul-Ashkal; Al-Biruni – Kitab-al-Hind; Ibn Khaldun – Al-Muqaddimah.

questions.q: 'Cwa' type of climate found in Middle Ganga plains is also experienced in which of the following places?
questions.exp: Madhya Ganga ke maidan tatha poorvi Australia me 'Cwa' prakaar ki jalvayu paayi jaati hai. C prakaar ki jalvayu (samsheetoshn aardra jalvayu) me sabse thande maheene ka ausat taapmaan 18°C se kam parantu (–)3°C (26.6°F) se adhik hota hai. Iske teen jalvayu prakaar: Cf – paschimi Europe tulya; Cw – China tulya; Cs – Rum sagariya.

questions.q: Who founded the Humanistic School of Geography?
questions.exp: Bhugol me manavtavaadi sampradaay ki sthapana Yi-Fu Tuan ne ki thi. Bhugol me manavtavaad ka aarambh apne sthool roop me beesvi shatabdi ke poorvardh me Blache ke netritva me Francisi bhugolvettaon dwara kiya gaya tha, jabki 'vishisht jeevan paddhati', aur sambhav manavtavaadi upagam ke hi vishisht swaroop hain. Julian Wolpert, William Kirk, Kirk, Gottmann, Gould tatha Pred jaise vyavaharvaadi upagam ke vikas me mahatvapurn yogdan diya.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT found in mica?
questions.exp: Abhrak ke mukhya ayask pegmatite hain, jo muscovite, biotite, phlogopite tatha lepidolite jaise khanijon ka samooh hain. Isme calcium nahi paaya jaata. Abhrak utpadan ke pramukh rajya kshetra: Andhra Pradesh – Nellore aur Khammam; Rajasthan – Jaipur tatha Udaipur; Jharkhand – Hazaribagh, Singhbhum; Bihar – Gaya, Bhagalpur, Munger.

questions.q: In a topographical map whose No. is 63 N, the distance between two objects is 4 cm. What will be the actual distance on the ground between those two points?
questions.exp: Ek sthalakritik maanchitra ya bhoopatrak, jiski sankhya 63N hai, usme do lakshyon ke beech ki doori 4 cm hai, to un dono binduon ke madhya sthal par vastavik doori 10 km hogi (63N 1:250,000 shreni ka maanchitra hai: 4 × 2.5 km = 10 km).

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a quantitative distribution map?
questions.exp: Varnprateeki (choroschematic) maanchitra matratmak vitaran maanchitra nahi hai. Maanchitron me abhikalpana (design) ki bhoomika mukhya roop se hoti hai. Iske aadhar par maanchitra ko mote taur par do bhaagon me baanta ja sakta hai: 1. amatratmak vitaran maanchitra – iska nirmaan naamik maapan-maapak ke aankdon ke prateekon se kiya jaata hai; 2. matratmak vitaran maanchitra – inme taapmaan, varsha, jansankhya, prati hectare utpadan aadi aankde maanchitrit kiye jaate hain.

questions.q: The long term objective of the National Population Policy (2000), is to achieve stable population by which year?
questions.exp: Rashtriya Jansankhya Neeti (2000) ka deerghkaalik uddeshya 2045 tak sthir jansankhya prapt karna hai. Rashtriya jansankhya neeti ki ghoshna garbh-nirodh, swasthya sambandhi aadhaarbhoot dhancha, swasthya karmiyon ki sankhya tatha ekikrit seva delivery ki maangon ko pooran karne ke atyavashyak lakshya ko haasil karne ke liye ki gayi thi. Is neeti ka uddeshya kul prajanan dar ko pratisthapan star yaani 2 bachche prati jodi tak laana hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT part of Purvanchal or the eastern hills and mountains?
questions.exp: Garo pahadiyan Poorvanchal athwa poorvi pahad aur parvat ka hissa nahi hain (ye Meghalaya pathar ka bhaag hain), jabki Patkai Bum, Naga pahadiyan, Manipur pahadiyan, Mizo tatha Lushai pahadiyan, poorvi pahadiyon ka hissa hain. Manipur ghati ke madhya 'Loktak jheel' sthit hai aur yah chaaron or se pahadiyon se ghiri hui hai. In pahadiyon par rehne wali janjatiyan jhoom aur sthanantari krishi karti hain.

questions.q: If radius of the reduced earth for the construction of graticule on a map projection is 'R', what would be the length of equator to make a graticule on Gall's projection?
questions.exp: Ek maanchitra prakshep par rekhajaal ke nirmaan hetu ghataayi gayi prithvi ka ardhvyas 'R' hai, to Gall prakshep par rekhajaal ki bhoomadhya rekha ki lambai 2πR cos45° hogi.

questions.q: Who among the following divided the world into population-resource regions?
questions.exp: Edward Ackerman ne vishwa ko paanch jansankhya-sansadhan pradeshon me vibhajit kiya: 1. Sanyukt Rajya America prakaar; 2. Europiya prakaar; 3. Brazilian prakaar; 4. Egyptian prakaar; 5. Arctic-marusthal prakaar. Jansankhyiki sankraman model W.S. Thompson ne 1929 me prastut kiya aur 1945 me Frank W. Notestein naamak janankikivid ne sanshodhit kiya.

questions.q: 'Orange Message' in cyclone warning system indicates:
questions.exp: Chakravat ek nimn vayudaab ka kendra hota hai, jiske chaaron taraf avasthit ucch vayudaab se nimn vayudaab kendra ki or atyadhik teevra chakriya gati se hawaein pravahit hoti hain. Bharatiya mausam vigyan vibhag dwara chaar prakaar ki chetavani jaari ki jaati hai, jise vibhinn rangon dwara samjhaya jaata hai: koi chetavani nahi – hara; chakravat ghadi (48 ghante pehle) – peela; chakravat chetavani (24 ghante pehle) – orange (narangi) yaani 'taiyar rahein'; chakravat (12 ghante pehle) – laal.

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
A. Geosyncline Theory B. Tetrahedral hypothesis C. Stationary wave D. Subsidence theory
1. Origin of tides 2. Origin of coral reefs 3. Mountain building 4. Origin of continents
questions.exp: Bhoosanati siddhant – parvat nirmaan; chatushfalak parikalpana – mahadweepon ki utpatti; sthir tarang siddhant – jwar ki utpatti; avtalan siddhant – praval bhittiyon ki utpatti.

questions.q: Salinity in ocean waters decreases when:
questions.exp: Bhaari varsha se mahasagariya jal ki lavanta ghatti hai. Mahasagaron, sagaron tatha jheelon me lavan ki matra ko prabhavit karne wale kaarakon ko 'niyantrak kaarak' kehte hain. In kaarakon me vashpikaran, varsha, nadi ke jal ka aagman, pawan, sagariya dharayein tatha lehrein aadi pramukh hain.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT an example of polycyclic relief?
questions.exp: Gokhur jheelein bahuchakriya sthalakriti ka udaharan nahi hain. Jab nadiyan apne visarp ko tyagkar seedhe pravahit hone lagti hain, to is tyage hue avashisht visarp me hi gokhur jheel ki utpatti hoti hai, jabki bahuchakriya sthalakriti ke antargat nick point, adhahkartit visarp, ghati ke andar ghati, nadi vedikayein, adhahkartit visarp tatha utthit samprapya maidan ko shaamil kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: Who among the following scholars has presented the classification of climate on the basis of precipitation effectiveness ratio?
questions.exp: Thornthwaite ne jalvayu ka vargikaran varshan prabhavita anupaat ke aadhar par prastut kiya. 'Varshan prabhavita' ka taatparya sampoorn varshik varsha ke keval us bhaag se hai, jo vanaspati ki utpatti tatha vikas ko prabhavit karta hai. Iske liye unhone varshan prabhavita anupaat (Precipitation Effectiveness Ratio = P/E Ratio) ka parikalan kiya. P/E soochi ke aadhar par Thornthwaite ne bhootal ko 5 aardrata mandalon me vibhakt kiya: tar (wet) – A – varshavan – 127 se oopar; aardra (humid) – B – van – 64–127; upaardra (sub humid) – C – ghaas ke maidan – 32–63; ardhshushk (semi-arid) – D – steppe – 16–31; shushk (arid) – E – marusthal – 16 se kam.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT found in Pyroxene mineral?
questions.exp: Pyroxene khanij me potassium nahi paaya jaata hai, jabki loha, calcium tatha magnesium paaya jaata hai.

questions.q: In which of the following regions is the Pangong lake, situated?
questions.exp: Pangong jheel poorvi Ladakh kshetra me avasthit hai. Ladakhi bhasha me 'Pangong' ka arth hai samipta aur Tibbati bhasha me 'tso' ka arth hai jheel. LAC rekha is jheel ke madhya me hokar guzarti hai, lekin Bharat aur China iski sateek sthiti ke vishay me sahmat nahi hain. Kuch anya mahatvapurn jheelein: Jammu-Kashmir – Dal, Wular, Anantnag, Nagin, Barinag; Uttarakhand – Nainital, Bhimtal, Khurpatal, Roopkund; Meghalaya – Umiam; Manipur – Loktak; Mizoram – Pala.

questions.q: Which one of the following gasses has the minimum percentage by volume in the earth's atmosphere?
questions.exp: Hydrogen gas ka prithvi ke vayumandal me aaytan ke aadhar par nyuntam pratishat hai. Vayumandal anek gaison ka yantrik sammishran hai jo jalvashp, dhool ke kanon se bana hai. Kuch mahatvapurn gaisein (pratishat me): nitrogen 78.8, oxygen 20.95, argon 0.93, CO₂ 0.036, neon 0.002, helium 0.0005, krypton 0.001, xenon 0.00009, hydrogen 0.00005.

questions.q: Which one of the following ocean current belong to the Indian ocean?
questions.exp: Agulhas jaldhara Hind mahasagar ki samudri jaldhara hai. Dakshini vishuvatiya dhara ki ek shakha Mozambique channel se hokar dakshin ki or pravahit hoti hai; 30° dakshini akshansh ke baad Mozambique dhara aur Madagascar ke poorvi tat ki dhara mil jaati hai, to iss dhara ko Agulhas jaldhara kehte hain. Jabki Labrador dhara, Antilles dhara tatha Canary dhara Atlantic mahasagar ki jaldharayein hain.

questions.q: Which sates of India is touched by three international borders?
questions.exp: Arunachal Pradesh teen antarrashtriya seemaon (China, Bhutan, Myanmar) ko sparsh karta hai. Bharat ki sthaliya antarrashtriya seemaon ki lambai 15200 km hai. Bharat ke padosi deshon se lagne wali seema: Bangladesh 4096.7, China 3488, Pakistan 3323, Nepal 1751, Myanmar 1643, Bhutan 699, Afghanistan 106 km. Note: aayog ne is prashn ka uttar Arunachal Pradesh maana hai, jabki Paschim Bangal bhi teen antarrashtriya seemaein (Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan) sparsh karta hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT recycled in the biosphere?
questions.exp: Paristhitik tantra ya jaivmandal me urja punah chakrit nahi hoti hai. Jaivmandal me urja ka pradhan srot surya hai; jaivmandal me saur urja ka nivesh (input) hota hai, jo uske tantra sanghatkon dwara vibhinn vidhiyon dwara punah nirgam (output) hota hai, jabki jaivmandal me bhoojaivrasayan chakra, jaliya chakra, carbon chakra, oxygen chakra tatha nitrogen chakra ka punah chakran hota hai.

questions.q: Chandra Prabha Wild Life Sanctuary is situated in which of the following districts?
questions.exp: Chandraprabha vanya jeev abhyaran Chandauli (Uttar Pradesh) jile me sthit hai. Kuch anya mahatvapurn vanya jeev vihar: Mahaveer Swami vanya jeev vihar – Lalitpur (1977); Hastinapur vanya jeev vihar – Meerut; Sohagi Barwa vanya jeev vihar – Maharajganj (1987); Pilibhit vanya jeev vihar – Pilibhit (2014).

questions.q: Incoming solar radiations on earth are absorbed maximum by which among the following?
questions.exp: Prithvi par aane wale saur vikiran ko jalvashp dwara sarvadhik avshoshit kiya jaata hai. Ozone parat samtapmandal me paayi jaati hai, jo surya se nikalne wali hanikarak parabaingani kiranon ko avshoshit karti hai; ozone prithvi ki satah se 15 se 50 km ki oonchai me paayi jaati hai, kintu iski sanghanta 15–35 km ke beech adhik hoti hai. CO₂ (0.036%) saur vikiran ke liye paradarshi, lekin parthiv vikiran ke liye apardarshi hai. Jalvashp ke kaaran hi vibhinn prakaar ke sanghanan evam varshan ke vibhinn roop jaise – badal, tushar, jalvrishti, him, os evam ole aadi ka nirmaan hota hai. Gyatavya hai ki vayumandal me samast jalmandal ka keval 0.001% bhaag jalvashp ke roop me hai.

questions.q: Who propounded theory of variations in solar radiation and climate change?
questions.exp: Saur vikiran vishmata evam jalvayu parivartan siddhant ka pratipadan Sir George Simpson dwara kiya gaya tha. Prithvi ki satah par vibhinn mausami ghatnayein prithvi ki satah tatha vayumandal ke beech saur urja ke sthanantaran aur vinimay par nirbhar karti hain; urja ka ek sthan se doosre sthan me sthanantaran parichalan (conduction), sanvahan (convection) tatha vikiran (radiation) dwara kiryanvit hota hai.

questions.q: Who gave the 'Fused Growth Theory' of urban growth?
questions.exp: Nagar vikas ka 'sanyukt vriddhi siddhant' Garrison dwara diya gaya. Iske anusaar kisi bhi nagar ka vikas uriya pratyakhsh me nagriya kendra se baahar yatayat margon ke sahare hota hai aur uske udyogon tatha niwas yogya kendron ke alag-alag samajik, aarthik aur kshetriya khand ban jaate hain. Kuch anya nagriya bhoomi upyog sambandhi siddhant: sankendriya katibandh siddhant – E.W. Burgess (1925); vikhandan siddhant – Homer Hoyt (1939); bahunabhik siddhant – Harris aur Ullman (1945).

questions.q: Sub-surface ocean circulation is affected by which among the following?
questions.exp: Upsatahi mahasagariya sanchalan taapmaan aur lavanta dono se prabhavit hota hai. Mahasagaron, sagaron tatha jheelon me lavan ki matra ko prabhavit karne wale kaarakon ko 'niyantrak kaarak' kehte hain; in kaarakon me vashpikaran, varsha, nadi ke jal ka aagman, pawan, sagariya jaldharayein tatha lehrein aadi pramukh hain.

questions.q: Which of the following presents the dualism in the nature of geography?
questions.exp: Pradeshik evam kramabaddh bhugol, bhugol me dvait ki prakriti ko prastut karta hai. Kramabaddh adhyayan paddhati ke vikasit karne me pratham mahatvapurn yogdan Humboldt ka maana jaata hai. Humboldt ki adhyayan paddhati anubhavik tatha aagamanatmak thi, jabki pradeshik upagam vastutah bhugol ka hriday hai; kyunki iska adhyayan kisi pradesh ya kshetra ke sandarbh me kiya jaata hai. Aadhunik pradeshik bhugol ke vikas me Karl Ritter ka mahatvapurn yogdan rahe hai; Hettner, Blache, Brunhes, Mackinder, Herbertson, Fleure, Hartshorne, Whittlesey, Stamp, Haggett aur De Martonne ne bhi is dvait me mahatvapurn kaarya kiye hain.

questions.q: The concept of 'stop-and-go determinism' was given by:
questions.exp: Taylor dwara pratipadit 'ruko aur jaao niyativaad' yah maanta hai ki manushya prakriti ka poorn niyantran nahi kar sakta, kintu prakriti ke prabhav ko asweekar nahi kiya ja sakta. Iske baad George Tatham ne Taylor ki vichardhara ko Canadian bhugolvettaon ke anusar 'vyavaharik sambhavvaad' ki sangya di. George Tatham ke anusar, 've apekshakrit sanyamit shabdavali ka prayog karte hain: niyantran ke sthan par prabhav ya pratikriya ya samayojan ka prayog karte hain.'

questions.q:
With reference to harmattan winds, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. It is a North-Easterly wind.
2. It flows over West Africa during the month of May and June.
questions.exp: Sirf 1 sahi. Paschim Africa me aur mukhyatah Sahara se garm, ati shushk aur dhoolipurn chalne wali prachand uttar-poorvi pawanon ko Harmattan kehte hain. Ye pawanein Guinea tat par nam ushna hawa se logon ko aaram deti hain aur swasthyavardhak hoti hain, isliye ise doctor wind bhi kehte hain (kathan 2 galat – ye sheet/shushk ritu me chalti hai). Paschim Australia ki ushna hawa ko brickfielder, USA me black roller tatha New Zealand me Norwester kehte hain.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT an example of denudational process?
questions.exp: Nikshepan anachhadan prakram ka udaharan nahi hai. Anachhadan me apakshay tatha apardan dono kriyaon ka samavesh kiya jaata hai. Is prakaar apakshay me keval sthaitik kriya aur apardan me gatisheel kriyaon ka yog hai. Prithvi ki satah par prakritik kaarakon dwara chattanon ke apne hi sthan par yantrik vidhi dwara toot-foot kar vighatan athwa rasayanik viyojan ki kriya ko 'apakshay' kehte hain.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Oil Refinary) with List-II (State of India):
A. Koyali B. Nagapattinam C. Numaligarh D. Barauni
1. Assam 2. Tamil Nadu 3. Gujarat 4. Bihar
questions.exp: Koyali – Gujarat; Nagapattinam – Tamil Nadu; Numaligarh – Assam; Barauni – Bihar.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Landforms) with List-II (Agents):
A. Pot Holes B. Sink Holes C. Palsa D. Lunette
1. Underground water 2. River 3. Wind 4. Periglacier
questions.exp: Jalgartika (pot holes) – nadi; ghol randhra (sink holes) – bhoomigat jal; palsa – parihimani; lunette – vayu.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT among the primary factors that influence the ocean currents?
questions.exp: Mahasagar tal ki sthalakriti mahasagaron ki dharaon ko prabhavit karne wale prathamik kaarakon me shaamil nahi kiya gaya hai, jabki Coriolis bal, pawan tatha mahasagar tal ki sthalakriti (gauṇ) mahasagariya dharaon ko prabhavit karte hain. Dharaon ki utpatti ke kaarakon ko 3 vrihad vargon me rakha jaata hai: 1. prithvi ke paribhraman se sambandhit kaarak – Coriolis bal, Ekman spiral; 2. mahasagaron se sambandhit kaarak – taapmaan me vibhinnata, lavanta me vibhinnata, ghanatva me vibhinnata; 3. bahya mahasagariya kaarak – vayudaab tatha hawaein, vashpikaran tatha varsha.

questions.q: Granite is which type of the following rocks?
questions.exp: Granite aagneya aur avsadi dono prakaar ki chattan hai (book ke vyakhya-vaakya me aisa likha hai, jabki sahi vikalp (c) 'aagneya aur roopantarit dono' chuna gaya). Aagneya chattan ko sthiti ke anusar do bhaagon me vibhakt kiya gaya hai: 1. bahirvedhi athwa bahya aagneya chattanein; 2. aantarik athwa antarvedhi aagneya chattanein. Antarvedhi chattanon ke antargat patalik chattanein, madhyavarti chattanein aati hain; granite patalik aagneya chattan ka sabse achha udaharan hai. Granite ka upyog bhavan nirmaan tatha sadak nirmaan ke liye kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: Cayman trough is located in which one of the following seas?
questions.exp: Cayman gart Caribbean sagar me sthit hai. Vishwa ki kul 57 garton me se 32 gart Prashant mahasagar me hain. Gart mahasagariya nital ke lagbhag 7 pratishat bhaag par faile hain. Kuch anya mahatvapurn gart: Mariana (u. Prashant) 11022 m; Tonga (m. dakshin Prashant) 10882 m; Puerto Rico (Atlantic) 8385 m; Kurile (Prashant) 10498 m; Romanche (d. Atlantic) 7631 m; Sunda/Java (poorvi Hind) 7450 m.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Original Rock) with List-II (Metamorphic Rock):
A. Limestone B. Sandstone C. Shale D. Granite
1. Quartzite 2. Marble 3. Schist 4. Slate
questions.exp: Limestone – sangmarmar (marble); sandstone – quartzite; shale – slate; granite – schist/gneiss.

questions.q: Who among the following Geographers named Quantitative Revolution as Civil War?
questions.exp: Dudley Stamp ne parimanatmak kranti ko grihyuddh ka naam diya. Matratmak ya parimanatmak kranti ke antargat ganitiya tatha sankhyikiya vidhiyon ka prayog karte hue bhaugolik tathyon tatha vastunisth vishleshan dwara adhik jor diya gaya. Matratmak kranti ke vikas me McCarty, Schaefer, Peter Haggett, Gregory, Chapman, Berry tatha Garrison aadi bhoogolvettaon ka mahatvapurn yogdan raha.

questions.q: Which one among the following is the largest Reservoir of water on the earth's surface?
questions.exp: Diye gaye vikalpon me jheelein prithvi ki satah par paani ka sabse bada bhandar hain. Bhootal ke 70.8 pratishat bhaag par jal aur 29.2 pratishat bhaag par sthal hai. Vartaman samay me prithvi par jal ka vitaran (dus lakh ghan km / kul jal %): mahasagar 1370 / 97.25; himaniyan evam himtopiyan 29 / 2.05; bhoomigat jal 9.5 / 0.68; jheelein 0.125 / 0.01; mrida me nami 0.065 / 0.005; vayumandal 0.013 / 0.001; nadiyan 0.0017 / 0.0001; jaivmandal 0.0006 / 0.00004.

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
A. Chinook B. Sirocco C. Bora D. Foehn
1. North Sahara desert 2. Eastern slopes of rocky Mountains 3. Eastern coast of Adriatic Sea 4. Switzerland
questions.exp: Chinook – Rocky parvat ke poorvi dhaal; Sirocco – uttari Sahara marusthal; Bora – Adriatic sagar ka poorvi tat; Foehn – Switzerland.

questions.q: Which one of the following is major source of carbon mono-oxide as air pollutant?
questions.exp: Petrol chalit vahanon se nikalne wala dhuan vayu-pradushak ke roop me carbon monoxide ka pramukh srot hai. Carbon monoxide (CO) rangheen, gandhheen gas hai; jiske utpadan ke srot jeevashm indhanon ke apoorn dahan se, swachalit vahanon, audyogik pratishthan, cigarette aadi hain. Iske haemoglobin ke saath sanyojan kshamta oxygen ki apeksha 300 guna adhik hone ke kaaran iski bahut alp matra bhi manushya me saans lene ki samasya utpann kar deti hai.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Names of Tropical cyclones) with List-II (Regions):
A. Hurricanes B. Typhoons C. Willy-Willy D. Taifu
1. Australia 2. Japan 3. U.S.A. 4. China
questions.exp: Hurricane – USA; Typhoon – China; Willy-willy – Australia; Taifu – Japan.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched? (Scholar – Model)
questions.exp: Boudeville – 'transport model' galat sumelan hai; book ke anusaar parivahan model Rimmer ka hai. Sahi: Myrdal – sanchayi kaaran model; Friedmann – kendra-upanth model; Frank – nirbharta model.

questions.q: Who among the following propounded the concept of 'Lebensraum'?
questions.exp: Friedrich Ratzel ne 'Lebensraum' (rehne ki jagah) ki avdharna ka pratipadan kiya. Ratzel pratham bhoogolvetta the jinhone bhaugolik adhyayan me manav ko sthayi aur mahatvapurn sthan pradaan karne ka agraniya kaarya kiya. Karl Haushofer 1924 me Munich vishwavidyalay me bhugol ke professor niyukt hue the; inhone bhoorajneeti ke kshetra me vishisht yogdan diya. W. Christaller dwara 'kendriya sthan siddhant' ka pratipadan kiya gaya; yah siddhant dakshin Germany ki bastiyon ke adhyayan par aadharit hai. 'Megalopolis' shabd ka prayog sarvapratham Jean Gottmann ne kiya tha.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Writer) with List-II (Book):
A. Carl Ritter B. R.E. Dickinson C. Richard Hartshorne D. David Harvey
1. The makers of modern Geography 2. Comparative Geography 3. Explanation in Geography 4. The nature of Geography
questions.exp: Book ka sumelan: Carl Ritter – Comparative Geography; R.E. Dickinson – The Makers of Modern Geography; Richard Hartshorne – The Nature of Geography; David Harvey – Explanation in Geography. (Is prashn ke kod scan me dhundhle hain; vikalp (b) book ke sahi sumelan ke anusaar rakha gaya hai.)

questions.q: The actual length of which of the following parallel of latitude is just half of the equator?
questions.exp: Bhoomadhya rekha ke uttar tatha dakshin jaane par akshanshon ka koniya moolya badhta hai, kintu unki lambai ghatti jaati hai. Is prakaar dhruviya bhaag ki or ucch akshansh tatha bhoomadhya rekha ki or nimn akshansh hota hai. 60° uttari tatha dakshini akshansh rekhaon ki lambai bhoomadhya rekha ki lagbhag aadhi hoti hai, jabki 80° uttari tatha dakshini akshansh rekha ki lambai 1/6 hai. Bhoomadhya rekha ke atirikt anya akshansh rekhaein laghu vritt kehlati hain.

questions.q: Mandakini river in Uttarakhand is also known by which one of the following names?
questions.exp: Uttarakhand me Mandakini nadi ko Kali Ganga naam se jaana jaata hai. Yah nadi Rudraprayag me Alaknanda se milti hai. Alaknanda nadi pravahit hoti hui Bhagirathi se Devprayag me milti hai, tatpashchat Ganga ke naam se pravahit hoti hai. Ganga ke daahine or se Yamuna, Prayag me aakar milti hai tatha baayein or se Ramganga, Ghaghra, Gandak tatha Kosi aadi nadiyan milti hain. Tatpashchat Ganga-Brahmaputra milkar vishwa ka sabse bada delta ka nirmaan karti hain.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Mineral) with List-II (Use of the mineral):
A. Kaynite B. Dolomite C. Steatite D. Apatite
1. Fertilizer 2. Soap 3. Steel 4. Glass
questions.exp: Kyanite – sheesha; dolomite – ispat; steatite – sabun; apatite – urvarak.

questions.q: The distance between two points on a map with scale 1 : 40000 is 4 cm. If the distance between same two points is 10 cm on the aerial photograph of the same area, what will be the scale of the aerial photograph?
questions.exp: Kisi kshetra ke maanchitra par jiska maapak 1:40000 hai, do sthanon ke beech ki doori 4 cm hai; usi kshetra ke hawai chhayachitra par unhi dono sthanon ke beech ki doori 10 cm hai, to hawai chhayachitra ka maapak 1:16000 hoga. Maapak 1:40000; doori 4 cm, yaani 1:40000 ka 4 = 160000 cm. Hawai chhayachitra par unhi dono sthanon (A-B) ke beech ki doori = 10 cm; 10 cm = 160000 (10:160000); 1 cm = 160000/10 = 16000; = 1:16000.

questions.q: The principal of optimum population was first presented by who among the following?
questions.exp: Anukooltam jansankhya ka siddhant sarvapratham Sidgwick dwara prastut kiya gaya. Is siddhant ke anusaar 'jansankhya badhne se desh me karyasheel jansankhya me vriddhi hone lagti hai, iske falswaroop utpatti vriddhi niyam laagu hone lagta hai, parantu is bindu ke pashchat, jab uplabdh sansadhanon ka poorn upyog ho chuka hota hai, tab shram ki ausat utpadakta arthat prati vyakti aay adhiktam hoti hai. Yahi bindu jansankhya ka anukool bindu hai.'

questions.q: The 'Death Valley' is known for which among the following?
questions.exp: 'Mrit ghati' atyadhik ushnata ke liye jaani jaati hai, jahan uttari America ka sarvadhik taapmaan Death Valley me ankit kiya jaata hai (55–56°C). Death Valley poorvi California me sthit ek registan hai. Yah Mojave registan me sthit uttari America ke sabse neeche, shushk tatha garm sthanon me se ek hai.

questions.q: Rural tourism was introduced in India in which of the following five year plans?
questions.exp: Bharat me gramin paryatan ki shuruaat dasvi panchvarshiya yojana ke dauran ki gayi thi. Dasvi panchvarshiya yojana (1 April 2002 – 31 March 2007) ka mukhya uddeshya upbhokta ke star me vriddhi tatha swasthya evam shiksha suvidhaon me sudhar laakar jeevan ki gunvatta ko behtar banana tatha samaveshi samriddhi ke saath asamaanta ko kam karna tha.

questions.q: A map is drawn on R.F. 1:5500 and it is reduced to half of its size, what would be its Representative Fraction?
questions.exp: Yadi ek maanchitra ki rachna pradarshak bhinna 1:5500 par ki jaati hai aur usko chhota karke aadha kiya jaata hai, to uska pradarshak bhinna 1:11000 hoga.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Mountain Pass) with List-II (State/Union Territory):
A. Mana B. Nathula C. Zojila D. Sipkila
1. Sikkim 2. Jammu and Kashmir 3. Himachal Pradesh 4. Uttrakhand
questions.exp: Mana – Uttarakhand; Nathu La – Sikkim; Zoji La – Jammu-Kashmir; Shipki La – Himachal Pradesh.

questions.q: The 'Transport Principle' in Christaller's Central Place Theory refers to:
questions.exp: Kendriya sthal siddhant (1933) me German bhoogolvetta Walter Christaller dwara pratipadit kiya gaya tha, jo dakshini Germany me basti ke pratiroop ke adhyayan par aadharit hai. Christaller ne nimnalikhit siddhanton ke anusaar kendriya sthalon ke teen alag-alag vyavasthaon ka ullekh kiya hai: 1. bazaar siddhant (K=3); 2. parivahan siddhant (K=4); 3. prashasnik siddhant (K=7).

questions.q:
Which of the following are not correctly matched? (Railway Zone – Headquarter)
1. North-Central – Gorakhpur 2. South-Central – Bilaspur 3. East-Central – Hajipur 4. West Central – Jabalpur
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (c) – 2 aur 1 (vikalp (a) '1 and 2' bhi wahi jodi hai). Sahi sumelan: uttar madhya – Prayagraj (Allahabad); dakshin madhya – Secunderabad; poorv madhya – Hajipur; paschim madhya – Jabalpur.

questions.q: Which of the following material is being transported by Big-Inch pipe line?
questions.exp: Big-Inch pipeline dwara petroleum ka parivahan kiya jaata hai. Yah pipeline USA me Mexico ki khaadi ke tateey kuon se khanij tel ko uttari-poorvi bhaagon tak pahunchane ke liye bichhaayi gayi hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a land-locked country?
questions.exp: Bhutan, Nepal tatha Afghanistan sthal aavrit desh hain, jabki Kuwait Faras ki khaadi ke uttari chhor par sthit ek samriddh khanij tel sampann desh hai, jiski rajdhani 'Kuwait' hai. 'Burgan pahadi' tatha Mina-al-Ahmadi pramukh tel kshetra hain.

questions.q: Who among the following has propounded the stationary wave theory of the origin of tides?
questions.exp: R.A. Harris ne jwar ki utpatti sambandhi 'sthaitik tarang siddhant' ka pratipadan kiya. Inke anusaar prithvi par jwar-bhata ki kriya dakshin mahasagar me uthne wali pragami tarangon ke kaaran nahi hoti, varan pratyek mahasagar me swatantra rup se sampadit hoti hai. Surya, chandrama ke aakarshan aur prithvi ke apkendriya bal (centrifugal force) ke kaaran sagariya jal ke oopar uthna jwar (tide) tatha neeche girna bhata (ebb) kehlata hai. Jwar bhata se sambandhit kuch anya mahatvapurn siddhant: santulan siddhant (1687) – Newton; pragami tarang siddhant (1833) – William Whewell; nahar siddhant (1842) – Airy.

questions.q: The earth was divided into natural regions by who among the following?
questions.exp: A.J. Herbertson ne prithvi ko 15 praakritik pradeshon me baanta tha. Herbertson ne vishwa ke vrihad praakritik pradeshon ke nirdhaaran me praakritik vanaspati ko pramukh aadhar maana tha; praakritik vanaspati mukhyatah jalvayu aur mitti dwara niyantrit hoti hai. Isiliye Herbertson ke praakritik pradesh adhikanshatah jalvayu pradeshon ka anukaran karte hain. Herbertson ki pramukh rachnaein: Recent Discussion on the Scope and Educational Approach to Geography (1904); Major Natural Regions: An Essay in Systematic Geography (1905); Man and His Work (1899); Geographical Survey of British Lakes.

questions.q: Which one of the following languages is NOT among the principal language of Jammu and Kashmir?
questions.exp: Pahari, Punjabi tatha Balti Jammu aur Kashmir ki pramukh bhasha hain, jabki Pashto Afghanistan ki bhasha hai. Bharat me lagbhag 200 bhashaein boli jaati hain. Urdu bhasha Uttar Pradesh, Bihar me; Kachchhi evam Sindhi paschim Bharat me; Odia, Odisha me; Assamiya, Assam me tatha Telugu bhasha Andhra Pradesh me boli jaati hai.

questions.q: The transition Zone between two ecosystems is known as:
questions.exp: Do paristhitik tantron ke beech ke sankraman kshetra ko ecotone kehte hain. Jab paristhitiki roop me samast paadapon tatha prajatiyon ka samuchchay roop se adhyayan kiya jaata hai, to use jeevom (biome) kehte hain.

questions.q: Which one of the following map projection is also called, the Elliptical Homographic Projection?
questions.exp: Mollweide prakshep ko andakaar homolographic prakshep bhi kaha jaata hai. Is prakshep ke vikas ka shrey German ke manchitrakar Karl Brandan Mollweide ko jaata hai. Ise Babinet ya Mollweide ka samkshetra prakshep bhi kaha jaata hai. Ise andakaar ya roodh prakshepon ke varg me sammilit kiya jaata hai. Yah ek samkshetra prakshep hai, jis par samuche globe ko bhali-bhaanti pradarshit kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT a warm current?
questions.exp: Canary dhara ek thandi jaldhara hai. Yah jaldhara uttari Africa ke paschimi tat ke sahare Madeira tatha Cape Verde ke beech pravahit hoti hai, jabki Kuroshio dhara, El Nino dhara tatha Mozambique dhara garm jaldharayein hain.

questions.q: Which one of the following Rn Values shows the random pattern of distribution of the points?
questions.exp: 1.0 Rn moolya binduon ke vitaran ka yadrchchhik pratiroop darshata hai. 'R' maan aur bikhraav ki prakriti: 0.01–0.30 samuhan (clustered); 0.31–0.60 ardh-samuhan (semi-clustered); 0.61–0.90 aniyata ki or (towards random); 0.91–1.10 aniyat (random); 1.11–1.40 alptam samroopiy (least uniform); 1.41–1.70 alp samroopiy (low uniform); 1.71–2.00 sanyat samroopiy (moderate uniform); 2.00 se adhik samroopiy (uniform).

questions.q: वायुमण्डल में उपस्थित ओजोन परत की ऊँचाई है
questions.exp: Ozone mandal samtap mandal ke nichle bhaag me 15 se 35 km ke beech saghan ozone gas ka mandal hai; iski oopari seema ~55 km tak. Ozone ka anu teen oxygen parmaanu ka hota hai aur parabaingani kiranon ko sokh kar prithvi ko bachata hai; ye monoatomic oxygen se takrakar ozone punah banta hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन जलविद्युत शक्ति की स्थापित क्षमता में प्रथम स्थान पर है?
questions.exp: Book ke anusaar sthapit jalvidyut kshamta me sheersh rajya: Karnataka 8.14%, Maharashtra 7.53%, Madhya Pradesh 7.29%. Sheersh jalvidyut utpadak rajya me Punjab pratham, dwitiya Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka teesra aur paanchve sthan par Madhya Pradesh (book).

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने बाजार प्रतिस्पर्धा सिद्धान्त की व्याख्या समुद्र तट पर आइसक्रीम विक्रेताओं की अवस्थिति के उदाहरण के माध्यम से की?
questions.exp: Hotelling ne bazaar pratispardha siddhant ko samudra tat par ice-cream vikretaon ki avasthiti ke udaharan se samjhaya. Chamberlin ne prithvi ki utpatti se sambandhit grahanu (planetesimal) parikalpana di.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जोड़ा सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
questions.exp: Vrishti chhaya pradeshon me varsha nahi hoti (ye atyant kam varsha wale pradesh hain), isliye chakravatiya varsha ke saath jodi galat. Antartam (core) prithvi ki aantarik parat hai; ye mukhyatah nikel aur lohe se bana hai; core ka 2900 se 5150 km ka bhaag taral avastha me aur 5150 se 6371 km tak ka bhaag thos avastha me.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित विद्वानों में से किसने 1935 में सर्वप्रथम 'पारिस्थितिक तंत्र' का प्रयोग किया?
questions.exp: A.G. Tansley ne 1935 me sarvapratham 'paristhitik tantra' shabd ka prayog kiya. Paristhitik tantra wah tantra hai jisme paryavaran ke jaivik aur ajaivik kaarak antarsambandhit hote hain; iski rachna me teen moolbhoot sanghatak – urja, jaivik aur ajaivik – hote hain. Ye apekshakrit sthir dasha me hota hai aur ek khula tantra hai.

questions.q: देश का आर्थिक विकास मापने के लिए, निम्नलिखित में से किस सूचक का सर्वाधिक प्रयोग किया जाता है?
questions.exp: Desh ka aarthik vikas maapne ke liye prati vyakti sakal rashtriya utpad (per capita GNP) soochak ka sarvadhik prayog kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: 1989 में योजना आयोग (अब नीति आयोग) ने भारत को कितने कृषि-जलवायु प्रदेशों में विभाजित किया है?
questions.exp: 1989 me Yojana Aayog ne Bharat ko 15 krishi-jalvayu pradeshon me baanta – mrida, jalvayu, jal sansadhan, bhoomi upyog aadi ke aadhar par: 1 paschimi Himalay, 2 poorvi Himalay, 3 Ganga ka nichla maidan, 4 Ganga ka madhya maidan, 5 Ganga ka oopari maidan, 6 trans-Ganga maidan, 7 poorvi pathar evam pahadiyan, 8 madhya pathar evam pahadiyan, 9 paschimi pathar evam pahadiyan, 10 dakshini pathar evam pahadiyan, 11 poorvi tateey maidan evam pahadiyan, 12 paschimi tateey maidan evam ghat, 13 Gujarat ke maidan evam pahadiyan, 14 paschimi shushk pradesh, 15 dweep pradesh.

questions.q: वेगनर के अनुसार, महाद्वीपीय विस्थापन के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा बल/शक्ति उत्तरदायी है?
questions.exp: Wegener ke anusaar mahadweepiya vishthapan ke liye jwariya bal uttardayi hai. Wegener (German jalvayu vaigyanik aur bhoobhautikshastri) ne 1912 me apna mahadweepiya pravah siddhant diya; pustak 'Origin of Continents and Oceans' (1915). Pangaea ke vighatan ke pashchat iska do dishaon me pravah hua: 1. gurutvabal ke prabhav se bhoomadhya rekha ki or; 2. surya aur chandrama ke jwariya bal ke kaaran paschim ki or.

questions.q: कोपेन के जलवायु वर्गीकरण के अनुसार गोवा के दक्षिण में पश्चिमी घाट की जलवायु निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार की है?
questions.exp: Köppen ke anusaar Goa ke dakshin me paschimi ghat ki jalvayu Amw hai. Bharat me: As – Tamil Nadu ka Coromandel tat; Aw – kark vritt ke dakshin prayadweepiya pathar ka adhikansh bhaag; Cwg – Ganga ka maidan, poorvi Rajasthan, uttari Madhya Pradesh, uttar-poorvi Bharat ka adhikansh pradesh.

questions.q: प्रशान्त महासागर में निम्नलिखित में से किसका सर्वाधिक क्षेत्रीय विस्तार है?
questions.exp: Prashant mahasagar me laal mrittika ka sarvadhik kshetriy vistaar hai. Akarbanik padarth ke nikshep me laal mrittika sarvadhik mahatvapurn hai kyunki ye agaadh sagariya jamavon me sabse adhik kshetron me paayi jaati hai. Iske nirmaan me aluminium ke silicate tatha lohe ke oxide ki matra sarvadhik hoti hai; ye 2700 fathom se adhik gahre bhaagon me paayi jaati hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक रेनूकूट (उ.प्र.) में हिंडाल्को की अवस्थिति का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण कारक है?
questions.exp: Sasti tatha paryapt shakti (urja) Renukoot (U.P.) me Hindalco ki avasthiti ka sabse mahatvapurn kaarak hai. Hindalco ki sthapana USA ki sahayata se 1958 me hui; Jharkhand ke Lohardaga khaan se bauxite aur Rihand pariyojana se sasti vidyut milti hai. Pramukh aluminium companiyan: Balco (1965) – Korba (Chhattisgarh) – Soviet sangh; Nalco (1981) – Damanjodi (Odisha) – France; Indalco (1938) – J.K. Nagar (Paschim Bangal) – Canada; Vedanta (1976) – Jharkhand – Germany; Malco (1965) – Salem (Tamil Nadu) – Italy.

questions.q: क्षोभमण्डल में वायु में गति (संचलन) निम्नलिखित में से किसके द्वारा होती है?
questions.exp: Saamanyatah kshobhmandal do upmandalon me vibhakt: (i) nichli parat ya gharshan parat – dharatal se 1 se 3 km tak; dharatal ki asmanata se hawa ki disha aur gati me gharshan aur rukawat; nichli parat me taapiya pratilomana ki kriya; (ii) doosri parat me vayumandaliya sanchalan aur chakravat-prati chakravat sakriya. Chakravat-prati chakravat ke nirmaan me vayudaab ki mukhya bhoomika; hawaein ucch vayudaab se nimn vayudaab ki or. Bhoomandal par vayu ki gati ke liye sarvadhik uttardayi kaarak vayudaab hai.

questions.q: विश्व के निम्नलिखित देशों में से कौन अपने कुल गेहूँ उत्पादन का वृहत्तम भाग (लगभग दो तिहाई) से अधिक निर्यात करता है?
questions.exp: Canada ki Red River ghati ko vishwa ki roti ki tokri kaha jaata hai. Winnipeg ko vishwa ki gehoon ki mandi kaha jaata hai; yahan se gehoon ka vyapar Manitoba pattan se hota hai. Canada apne kul gehoon utpadan ka do-tihai hissa niryat kar deta hai. Vishwa ka sabse bada gehoon aayatak desh – Egypt; sheersh gehoon utpadak – China, Bharat, Rus, USA, France.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने जनसंख्या वृद्धि के लॉजिस्टिक वक्र सिद्धान्त को प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.exp: Pearl Reed ne jansankhya vriddhi ke logistic vakra siddhant ka pratipadan kiya. Sadler ka jansankhya sambandhi siddhant Malthus ke siddhant ke theek vipreet; Sadler ke anusaar jansankhya ghanatva ke saath manushya ke vaanchhit swabhaav ki prakriti ghatti hai – manushya ki ichchha aur prajanan kshamta tatha jansankhya ghanatva me pratilomanupaatik sah-sambandh. D. Castro ne bataya bhojan me ucch protein ki matra ka prajanan kshamta ke saath rinatmak sambandh hota hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित शैल समूहों में कौन सबसे पुराना है?
questions.exp: Bharat me paayi jaane wali chattan/shail samooh ka kram: (i) Archaean samooh (450–250 crore varsh poorv); (ii) Dharwar kram (250–150 crore); (iii) Cuddapah kram (150–60 crore); (iv) Vindhyan kram (150–60 crore); (v) Gondwana kram (30–7 crore); (vi) tritiyak kram (7–1 crore); (vii) chaturthak kram (1 crore BC se ab tak). Dharwar kram ki chattanein Archaean ke prathamik chattanon ke apardan aur nikshep se nirmit; ye jeevashm rahit hain. Iska vikas mukhyatah Karnataka ke Dharwar, Bellary aur Shimoga jilon me; saath hi Aravali shreni tatha Chhota Nagpur pathari kshetra me bhi.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित स्थानीय पवनों में से जो ठंडी पवन नहीं है, उसका चयन करें।
questions.exp: Norwester garm pawan hai. Norwester, New Zealand me parvatiya kshetron se utarne wali ushna shushk pawan hai. Bora Europe ke parvatiya kshetron se Yugoslavia ke Adriatic tat ki or bahne wali thandi hawa hai; isse mukhyatah Italy aur Yugoslavia prabhavit hote hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में कौन म्यांमार के साथ भारत की समुद्री सीमा बनाता है?
questions.exp: Coco channel Myanmar ke saath (uttari Andaman ke madhya) Bharat ki samudri seema banata hai. Arab sagar dweep Lakshadweep samooh ka dakshini dweep Minicoy 8° channel dwara Maldives se alag hota hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने मृदा निर्माण के कारकों से सम्बन्धित समीकरण (सूत्र) को प्रस्तुत किया?
questions.exp: H. Jenny ne 1941 me mrida ke nirmaan ko prabhavit karne wale kaarakon ko nimnlikhit sameekaran ke roop me prastut kiya: mrida, jalvayu, jeevon, uchchavach, aadhar shail aur samay ka phalan, arthat S = F(cl, o, r, p, t), jahan S = mrida parichhedika, F = phalan, cl = jalvayu, o = jaivik kaarak, r = uchchavach, p = aadhar shail, t = samay. Note: prasiddh American vidwan C.F. Marbut ne 1938 me pehli baar anuvanshik mrida vargikaran prastut kiya jo vyapak mrida vargikaran vyapak tantra ki yojana ke naam se vikhyat hai.

questions.q: भारत सरकार द्वारा 1980 में पारित वन संरक्षण अधिनियम का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: इमारती लकड़ी की उपलब्धि सुनिश्चित करना
questions.exp: Van sanrakshan adhiniyam (1980) ka mukhya uddeshya vanon ka vinaash aur van bhoomi ko gair-vaniki kaaryon me upyog se rokna tha. Is adhiniyam ke prabhavi hone ke pashchat koi bhi van bhoomi kendra sarkar ki anumati ke bina kisi anya kaarya ke liye prayog me nahi laayi ja sakti aur na hi arakshit ki ja sakti hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित विद्वानों में से किसने सर्वप्रथम 1960 में सागर नितल प्रसरण की संकल्पना को प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.exp: Harry Hess ne sarvapratham 1960 me sagar nital prasaran ki sankalpana ka pratipadan kiya. Hess ne plate vivartaniki siddhant se sambandhit apni sankalpana prastut ki. Wegener ne mahadweepiya pravah siddhant 1912 me diya; unhone bataya ki Sial roopi mahadweepiya sthalkhand Sima par tair raha hai; Carboniferous yug me Pangaea ka vikhandan hua, uske uttari bhaag ko Laurasia tatha dakshini bhaag ko Gondwanaland kaha gaya; dono sthalkhandon ke madhya ek chhichhla sagar bana jise Tethys sagar kaha gaya.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक ह्विटलसी द्वारा कृषि प्रदेशों के सीमांकन में एक आधार तत्त्व के रूप में प्रयुक्त नहीं हुआ है?
o: कृषि उत्पाद के उपयोग/उपभोग का ढंग
कृषि यंत्रों के उपयोग, आवास, जीवन-स्तर आदि से सम्बन्धित दशाएँ
questions.exp: Sarvapratham 1936 me D. Whittlesey ne vishwa ke krishi pradeshon ka seemankan kiya aur vishwa ko 13 krishi pradeshon me vibhajit kiya. Iske liye unhone paanch aadhar apnaye: (i) fasal tatha pashuon ka sahcharya; (ii) krishi utpad ke upyog/upbhog ka dhang; (iii) bhoomi upyog ki gahanta; (iv) krishi utpad ka sansaadhan tatha vipanan; (v) mashinikaran ka star tatha krishi sambaddh bhavanon tatha anya sanrachnaon ke prakaar evam sanyojan. Prati hectare paidavar aadhar nahi tha.

questions.q: वर्ष 1969 में निम्नलिखित पत्रिकाओं में से किसके प्रकाशन के साथ मानवतावादी भूगोल, भूगोल का एक प्रमुख चिन्तनफलक बन गया?
questions.exp: Worcester ke Clark vishwavidyalay me varsh 1969 me Antipode naamak ek shodh patrika ki sthapana ki gayi, jisme ugra sudharvaadi lekhon ka prakashan kiya jaata tha. Is patrika ke pramukh mudde – nagariya nirdhanata, mahilaon ke saath pakshpaat, kaale rang ke logon aur alpsankhyakon ke viruddh bhed-bhaav, samajik suvidhaon ka asamaan vitaran, apraadh vanchan aadi. Ugrasudharvaadi bhugol ke mukhya lakshan: pratyakshvaad tatha matratmak kranti ki kamiyon ko logon ke saamne laana; poonjivaadi deshon me asamaanta, bhed-bhaav, abhaav, swasthya, apraadh tatha paryavaran nimnikaran jaise muddon par dhyan; mahilaon ke viruddh bhed-bhaav door karne hetu sanskritik kranti; pradeshik asamaantaon ko door karna; shwet jaati ke logon ki shreshthata par prashnachinh. Note: bhugol me ugra sudharvaad ka janm 1970 ke dashak me matratmak kranti tatha pratyakshvaad ki pratikriya me hua.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है? (स्थानीय हवाएँ – स्थान)
questions.exp: Gibli ek garm hawa hai jo Libya me pravahit hoti hai. California me garm hawa 'Santa Ana' pravahit hoti hai.

questions.q: सिराको (सिरक्को) (Sirocco) है
questions.exp: Sirocco Sahara marusthal se bhoomadhya sagar (Italy) me pravahit hone wali ek garm, shushk tatha retili vayu hai. Italy me jab barish hoti hai to isme baalu ke kanon ke kaaran varsha ki boondein laal rang ki ho jaati hain; is prakaar ki varsha ko Italy me rakt ki varsha kaha jaata hai.

questions.exp: Mahadweepiya dhaal samapt hote hi mahasagariya dhaal 1° se bhi kam ho jaata hai, yahin se mahasagariya maidan praarambh hota hai. Iski gahrai 3000 m se 6000 m ke beech paayi jaati hai. Yah mahasagariya nital ke 75.9% bhaag par faila hai; yah Atlantic ke 55%, Prashant ke 80.3% tatha Hind mahasagar ke 80.1% bhaag par vistrit hai. questions.exp: Bharat me pehli baagh ganana varsh 1972 me ki gayi thi. 1969 me 'Antarrashtriya Prakriti evam Prakritik Sanghatan Sanrakshan' (IUCN) sangh ke 10ve adhiveshan me yah nirnay liya gaya ki baaghon ki sampoorn suraksha aur samvardhan ke liye kadam uthaye jaayein. 1 April 1973 ko Jim Corbett (Uttarakhand) rashtriya udyaan me baagh pariyojana ki shuruaat ki gayi. Desh ke 18 rajyon me 51 baagh sanrakshan abhyaran hain. Kshetrafal ki drishti se sabse bada baagh arakshit kshetra Nagarjunasagar Srisailam (Andhra Pradesh) hai jabki sabse chhota Pench (Maharashtra) hai.

questions.exp: Seema raashtra ka bhoovainyasik kaarak nahi hai. Raashtra ki avdharna ke vikas ke pramukh charan nimn hain: (a) rakt sambandh (b) parivaar ka vikas (c) samaaj ka vikas (d) kshetriya astitva (e) pradeshik rajneetik vichaaron ka vikas (f) rashtriyata ka vikas (g) raashtra ka vikas.

questions.exp: Vaishvik ushman ka pramaan nimnlikhit kaarakon se spasht hota hai: (i) vayu taapmaan me vriddhi (ii) parvatiya evam mahadweepiya himnadiyon ka pighalna (iii) varsha praroop me parivartan (iv) tateey maanav bastiyon ka jalmagn hona (v) praval viranjan ki samasya me vriddhi; tateey paryatan evam krishi par dushprabhaav padne ki sambhavna; baadh, samudri toofan jaise hurricane ki teevrata aur baarambaarata me vriddhi aadi. Nagarikaran aur nirvanikaran iske kaaran hain, pramaan nahi.

questions.exp: Paryavaran suraksha adhiniyam 1986 ee. me paarit hua. Hum jeevdhariyon tatha vanaspatiyon ke chaaron or jo aavaran hai use paryavaran kehte hain. questions.exp: Bhoomandaleey taap vriddhi ko praval viranjan ka mukhya kaaran maana jaata hai. Jab saagariya jal ke saamanya ausat taapmaan me 1°C se adhik ki vriddhi ho jaati hai to shaival rang ke safed ho jaate hain. Praval inhi shaivalon ko aahar ke roop me grahan karte hain. Ye shaival prakash sanshleshan me asamarth ho jaate hain evam samapt hone lagte hain; parinaamswaroop prachur aahar ke abhaav me praval marne lagte hain – is samast prakriya ko praval viranjan kehte hain. Praval bhittiyon ki utpatti ke pramukh siddhant: avtalan – Darwin; sthir sthal – Murray; himani niyantran – Daly; avtalan siddhant – William Morris Davis.

questions.exp: Chhichhli lagoonon wale laghu atollon ki shrinkhala ko Faros kehte hain. Vishwa me sabse badi atoll mahasagariya dweep me paayi jaati hai ise Funafuti atoll kehte hain. Registan ke bhaagon me parvaton se ghiri basin ko bolsan kehte hain. questions.exp: Jab jansankhya ghanatva, kul jansankhya ko krishi yogya bhoomi se vibhajit karke prapt kiya jaata hai to use kayik ghanatva kehte hain. Krishi ghanatva = krishakon ki sankhya / krishi yogya bhoomi ka kshetrafal.

questions.exp: A. Siegfried ne nirvachan bhugol par adhyayan kiya tha. German bhugolvetta A. Siegfried ki pramukh kritiyan: (1) Basis of Landscape Science; (2) City of the World. American bhugolvetta William Bunge ki pramukh kriti: Theoretical Geography.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में कौन बारम्बारता बंटन की केन्द्रीय प्रवृत्ति का परिकलित माप है?
questions.exp: Maadhya baarambaarta bantan ki kendriya pravritti ki parikalit maap hai. Bahulak ya mode ka sankhyiki me prayog adhiktam aavritti wale moolya ke liye kiya jaata hai. Kisi samank shreni ke moolyon ko aarohi athwa avrohi kram me vyavasthit karne ke pashchat jo moolya shreni ke madhya me sthit hota hai use shreni ka maadhyika moolya kehte hain.

questions.q: स्टेलेग्माइट्स क्या है?
questions.exp: Stalagmites nikshepit sthalakriti hai. Kandara ki chhat se risne wale jal ki maatra yadi kuch adhik hoti hai to vah seedhe tapak kar kandara ke farsh par pahunch jaati hai. Is prakaar kandara ke farsh par nikshepan stambh ka nirmaan hota hai. Dheere-dheere in stambhon ki oonchai oopar ki or badh jaati hai; is prakaar ke stambhon ko stalagmites kehte hain.

questions.exp: 'The Influence of Sea Power upon History' ke lekhak Alfred Thayer Mahan hain. Spykman ne Rimland siddhant ka pratipadan kiya. Spykman ne 1944 me shanti ka bhugol naamak pustak likhi.
